description: AI-generated rainy-walkway example: the formula combines detector wetness, moisture probe output, rain-rate estimate, and camera exposure to study slip-risk style wet-surface errors.

hypotheses.name: estimated_rain_rate
hypotheses.label: Rain-rate estimate vs GT rain-rate
hypotheses.condition: col('Estimated Rain Rate (mm/h)') == col('GT Rain Rate (mm/h)')

hypotheses.name: heavy_rain_and_gusts
hypotheses.label: Heavy rain with gusty wind
hypotheses.condition: col('Estimated Rain Rate (mm/h)') >= 7 and col('Wind Speed (m/s)') >= 5

hypotheses.name: shadowed_camera_at_dusk
hypotheses.label: Shadowed camera at dusk
hypotheses.condition: col('Camera Exposure') <= col('GT Exposure') - 15 and col('GT Exposure') >= 110

hypotheses.name: spray_from_traffic
hypotheses.label: Traffic spray raises local wetness
hypotheses.condition: col('Wind Speed (m/s)') >= 6 and col('Measured Wetness (%)') - col('GT Wetness (%)') >= 15
